citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The facility is storing prescription medications and injectables in temperatures excess of manufacturer's direction. The
ambient temperature of the barn was 92F at time of inspection. Printed temperature storage ranges on the bottles are
68F-77F and 59F-86F. Failure to use appropriate methods to store medications for use in the veterinary care program
may result in subpar treatment response or injury to the animals. Each exhibitor shall establish and maintain adequate
programs of veterinary care that include the use of appropriate methods to prevent, control, diagnose and treat diseases
and injuries.
Correct from this date forward of 10 June 2026.

citations.desc: Environment enhancement to promote psychological well-being.
citations.narrative:
At the time of inspection, the facility did not provide an adequately detailed environmental enhancement plan for the
pheasants on hand. The plan is missing documentation in regards to special considerations, restraint devices, and
exemptions. The plan is a list of three items, one of which vaguely references the social aspect ("human interaction"). A
written plan addressing the specific needs of birds is necessary to ensure that the overall health, well-being, and
psychological needs of the animals are being appropriately met. The facility must develop, document, and follow a
species-appropriate plan for environment enhancement adequate to promote the psychological well-being of the birds.
The plan must be approved by the attending veterinarian and must address social grouping, environmental enrichment,
special considerations, restraint devices, and exemptions.
Correct by 10 July 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensees.
